title: Public contract shared definitions (v1.0)
description: Reusable public-safe definitions for v1.0 wire objects. These definitions constrain structure only. They do not grant authority, imply a decision, or specify private signing, trust, or admission implementation.

utcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC, Z only; offsets forbidden; leap-second 60 excluded; calendar validity (impossible month/day combinations, non-leap-year February 29) is enforced by conformance tests because it is not regex-expressible.

nonEmptyOpaqueRefArray.description: Non-empty unique opaque-reference array. Ascending UTF-16 code-unit order REQUIRED on the wire, enforced by conformance tests.
